items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You know, Bud Freeman even wrote a book called, You Don't Look Like a Musician.

ctx.x: I was a jazz musician if somebody didn't tell them that Cozy Cole was a jazz musician. Sometimes you just feel bad, and say oh yeah, I'm a jazz musician, the first thing they're going to do is put you down, because I remember a time with Cab and all that goodness, he used to play those dances and the doctors and lawyers and their wives and businessmen and all that used to come out to the dances and see you. Recently, here lately you just didn't see them because jazz got such a bad name, and they just figured…
You know, Bud Freeman even wrote a book called, You Don't Look Like a Musician.
Yeah, yeah, he's in England now, isn't he?
